name: Citizens Financial Group

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Citizens Financial Group logo.svg)

description: Citizens is a Providence-based regional bank holding company with $226.4B of assets and $183.3B of deposits, with branches in New England, the Mid-Atlantic and Midwest and a private bank in California, Florida, New York and Massachusetts. It earns 71 percent of its $8.2B revenue from net interest income (spread on loans and deposits) and the rest from fees. Consumer Banking is 69 percent of the two segments' revenue (6,224 of 8,997, computed) and 64 percent of their net income. It repurchased $600M of stock in 2025.

businessLines.name: Consumer Banking
businessLines.how: Consumers and small businesses pay loan interest (mortgage, home equity, credit cards, small business, education and point-of-sale loans) and fees, served through about 1,000 branches (117 in-store) and digital channels; 80 percent of revenue is net interest income (4,972 of 6,224, computed). Net income grew from 1,253.

businessLines.name: Commercial Banking
businessLines.how: Companies and institutions pay loan and lease interest, deposit and treasury-management fees, foreign exchange and risk-management, and syndication fees; 64 percent of revenue is net interest income (1,778 of 2,773, computed) and net income fell from 973.

businessLines.name: Other (computed residual)
businessLines.how: Not a customer business: treasury, securities portfolio and corporate items; revenue and profit computed as consolidated minus the two segments (the segment note table was not read for this line).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), computed residual of consolidated net income 1,831 less the two segments
